Get started

Run Machinist on your computer

Set up the control plane and a runner on your own machine in four steps. You need Go, Git, the GitHub CLI and Claude Code. Sign in to the GitHub CLI and Claude Code first. You do not need a Machinist account.

  1. 01

    Build

    Build one program. It has the CLI, the control plane, the runner and the web app. Add it to your PATH.

  2. 02

    Initialize

    Make a new directory and keep it in git. Run this there. It writes the config, a runner and the starter steps.

  3. 03

    Configure

    In config.yaml, set github.handle to your GitHub login and list the repositories jobs may work on. In runner.yaml, set env: [] and turn on login: true.

  4. 04

    Start

    Start the control plane. In a second terminal, run GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) machinist runner start. Make a token with machinist token create "$USER". Sign in to the web app and select New job.
